subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memorySearch.extraPaths ingest arbitrary JSONL raw message logs, or should raw JSONL recall stay outside the builtin Markdown/multimodal memory path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but widening builtin ingestion changes sensitive transcript/log visibility and may conflict with VISION.md's lean-core and plugin-boundary guidance unless maintainers sponsor the core behavior.

options.title: Document supported alternative
options.body: Keep builtin memory extra paths Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

options.title: Add native builtin JSONL
options.body: Implement JSONL as a first-class builtin memory format with line-aware parsing, watcher and memory_get support, tests, docs, and privacy guardrails.

options.title: Design plugin/API first
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or memory API extension should own arbitrary raw-log ingestion.

recommendation.title: Document supported alternative
recommendation.body: Keep builtin memory extra paths Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.
